title: Building facades: paint and repairs by bucket crane
lines: A crack in the facade, peeling paint, a broken gutter?
A bucket crane reaches every floor, no scaffolding.
Work starts the same day, not after a week of setup.
The basket moves along the wall and the job keeps flowing.
Saving time, money and mess in the yard.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Every floor, no scaffolding.
